title: ExternalCorrectionSuggestions
description: Correction suggestions returned by an external provider for one submission. Imported via scripts/import_suggestions.py, which maps this to PUT /provider/changes. All entries are stored under the provider's own corrector record and remain editable suggestions for the human correctors.

name.description: Display name of the provider, e.g. shown in the disclaimer

disclaimer.description: Note that these are AI generated suggestions. The import script prepends it to the summary text.

comments.description: Marginal comments anchored to word positions of the essay text

key.description: Stable unique key per comment, e.g. 'ai-c1'. Re-importing with the same key updates the comment.

start_position.description: First word of the commented passage (word index in the essay text, as counted by the corrector app)

end_position.description: Last word of the commented passage

parent_number.description: Paragraph number the positions refer to (PDF/page based corrections); null for text based corrections

rating.description: 'cardinal' = serious error, 'excellent' = outstanding passage, null = neutral

points.description: Partial points attached to this comment, each bound to a non-general rating criterion

criterion_points.description: Points for general criteria (not attached to a comment)

status.description: Grading status to set. 'pre_graded' keeps the suggestion clearly non-final; 'authorized' makes comments and points visible to the other correctors (workflow checks of the assessment apply).
